\begin{tablenotes}\footnotesize
\item Matched-frame accuracy: the share of (paragraph, technology, frame) units fired by both the first coding and the model on which the evaluation agrees (208 pooled, 94 German, 114 English units). Matched-row accuracy: the share of (paragraph, technology) rows named by both on which the comparison target agrees (158 pooled, 69 German, 89 English rows). End-to-end F1 is the micro-F1 over all (paragraph, technology, frame, evaluation) or (paragraph, technology, comparison target) tuples, so a frame or row that one side missed counts as an error. Micro-F1 pools the tuples of all classes.
\item Macro-F1 is the point estimate over the classes with positive reference support (count after the interval); its interval is the available-class macro over resamples. Per-language macros use each language's own class set and are not direct language contrasts. The exact-match rate carries no interval. Unweighted figures and the per-population defined-class distributions are in the evaluator's output file \texttt{table1\_primary.csv} (electronic appendix).
\end{tablenotes}
